entries.jp: ‥‥{v:00B9}まあな。{p}{v:00BA}だが、気にしないでくれ。{n}{s:001B}様が昔のように戻られただけで十分だ。
entries.en: ...{v:00B9}Yes, it was.{p}{v:00BA}But do not concern yourselves. It is enough that Lord{n}{s:001B} is himself again.

entries.jp: {v:00BB}{s:001B}様のことは、気にしないでくれ。
entries.en: {v:00BB}Do not concern yourselves about Lord{n}{s:001B}.

entries.jp: {v:00BC}やぁ、君たちには何度お礼を言っても、{n}言い足りないね。
entries.en: {v:00BC}Ah, I could thank you a hundred times, and it would{n}still not be enough.

entries.jp: {v:00BD}でも、親友だったあの偽の王様、{n}牢屋に入れられちゃったんでしょ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:00BD}But that false king was your best friend, and they put{n}him in prison, didn't they...?

entries.jp: {v:00BE}生きているなら、それだけでいいさ。{p}{v:00BF}２人のどちらかが敵になれば、どちらかが生き残る。{n}そして生き残った方が陛下を最後まで守る。{p}{v:00C0}それがアーネストと話し合って決めていたことだ。{n}その誓いは果たせたしね。
entries.en: {v:00BE}As long as he is alive, that is enough.{p}{v:00BF}If the two of us ended up on opposite sides, one of us{n}would survive. The survivor would protect His Majesty{n}to the very end.{p}{v:00C0}That was what Ernest and I agreed upon. And we{n}fulfilled that vow.

entries.jp: {v:00C1}君たちには感謝しているよ。{p}{v:00C2}さ、今は楽しもう。
entries.en: {v:00C1}I am grateful to you.{p}{v:00C2}Come, let us enjoy ourselves for now.

entries.jp: どうぞお楽しみ下さい。
entries.en: Please enjoy yourselves.

entries.jp: {v:0000}　　　　　　{FFEE}クックックックッ！{n}　　　　　　愚かな人間どもめ‥‥！{FFF1}
entries.en: {v:0000}{FFEE}Heh heh heh heh! Foolish humans...!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0001}何！？{n}この声？{n}どこから聞こえるの？
entries.en: {v:0001}What?! That voice! Where's it coming from?

entries.jp: {v:0002}　　　　　{FFEE}聞こえるか、愚かな人間ども！{FFF1}
entries.en: {v:0002}{FFEE}Can you hear me, foolish humans?!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0003}やっぱり聞こえる！{n}どこから！？
entries.en: {v:0003}There it is again! Where's it coming from?!

entries.jp: {v:0004}頭の中に直接‥‥。{n}この波動は‥‥グローシュ！？{p}‥‥{v:0005}グローシアンの技術なの！？
entries.en: {v:0004}Directly into my mind... These waves... Grosh?!{p}...{v:0005}Is this a Growsian technique?!

entries.jp: {v:0006}すごいなぁ、こんな技術を持っていたのか‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0006}Amazing... I had no idea they possessed such a{n}technique...

entries.jp: {v:0007}感心してる場合かよ！
entries.en: {v:0007}This ain't the time to be impressed!

entries.jp: {v:0008}{FFEE}ついに‥‥私はついに、すべての力を取り戻した！{n}　　　　もう人間のふりをする必要はない！{n}　　　　　覚悟しろ、愚かな人間ども！{FFF1}
entries.en: {v:0008}{FFEE}At last... At last, I have regained all my power! I no{n}longer need to pretend to be human! Prepare{n}yourselves, foolish humans!{FFF1}
...{v:0009}That voice... My teacher...?

entries.jp: {v:000B}{FFEE}　　　　　　我が名は{s:0022}。{n}　　　　　キング・オブ・グローシアン。{n}　　　　　お前たちの支配者たる存在だ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {v:000B}{FFEE}My name is {s:0022}. King of the Growsians.{n}Your rightful ruler.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:000C}支配者だと！？
entries.en: {v:000C}Our ruler?!

entries.jp: {v:000D}{FFEE}　　　{s:0116}を倒して浮かれているようだが、{n}　　　我が能力をあの程度と一緒にするなよ。{n}　　　いわば、あれは旧型なのだからな！{FFF1}
entries.en: {v:000D}{FFEE}You seem quite elated at having defeated{n}{s:0116}, but do not mistake that paltry{n}strength for the measure of my power. That was{p}merely an obsolete model, so to speak!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:000E}それじゃ、あのフェザリアンが言ってた？
entries.en: {v:000E}Then, is this what that Featherian was talking about?

entries.jp: {v:000F}{FFEE}これから、この{s:0022}様の支配が始まるのだ！{n}　　　　　　まずは手始めに、{n}　　このランザック王城を吹き飛ばしてくれる！{FFF1}
entries.en: {v:000F}{FFEE}Now begins the reign of the great {s:0022}!{n}And for my first act, I shall blow this royal castle of{n}Ranzak to pieces!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0011}待て、ウェーバー！
entries.en: {v:0011}Wait, Weber!
{v:0012}Don't stop me, {s:0002}!

entries.jp: {v:0013}今から急いでも、{n}お前が向こうに帰るまでに、{n}どれくらいかかると思ってるんだ？
entries.en: {v:0013}Even if you leave right now, how long do you think it'll{n}take you to get back there?

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0014}くっ！{n}しかし、このまま黙っているわけには‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0014}Damn! But I can't just stand here and do nothing...

entries.en: {v:0015}Come with us!

{v:0018}I owe you...

entries.en: {v:001E}I'm sure true peace will come once we defeat him. Come{n}on, let's give it our all!

entries.en: ...{v:001F}I see. Well, it can't be helped. I'll stay here a little while{n}and see how things go.{p}{v:0020}Come and get me whenever you need my help.

entries.jp: {s:0005}をパーティーに加えますか？

{v:0025}All right!

entries.en: {v:002A}As King, I will do everything I can. First, I will mobilize{n}the army to support you.

Curse you, {s:0022}...
